title: Opportunity
description: Normalized representation of a single job, freelance, or hidden-opportunity record.

id.description: Deterministic id derived from company+title+location+source_url (see scripts/lib/dedup.py).

source.description: Name of the source as registered in config/sources.yaml.

salary_period.description: Production audit (V1.4.x): distinguishes an annual figure from an hourly/project rate so market_intelligence never averages incompatible units.

salary_source.description: Where the figure came from, e.g. 'posting' (stated in the listing) or 'estimate' (inferred) — never blank when a salary is present, so an estimate is never mistaken for a disclosed figure.

salary_confidence.description: OBSERVED = stated verbatim in the source; ESTIMATED = inferred from partial data; LOW_CONFIDENCE = present but unreliable. Never defaults to OBSERVED — null until explicitly set.

reason.description: Human/engine-readable justification for the score and priority.

provenance.description: V1.3 web intelligence layer: where this record came from. Separate from match_score.

confidence_score.description: Extraction/source reliability (0-100) — NOT the opportunity match_score.

lifecycle_status.description: Posting freshness, distinct from the application-pipeline `status` field.

alternate_sources.description: Other sources/URLs found to point at the same underlying opportunity (duplicate intelligence, Phase 23).

company_canonical.description: Resolved canonical company name when entity resolution is confident (Phase 24); null when not attempted or uncertain.
